[ASSISTANT_SAID] Kickboxing improves flexibility, coordination, and overall fitness.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended exercises to improve flexibility include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Upper Body:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Shoulder Rolls: Roll shoulders forward and backward for 10-15 reps.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Chest Stretch: Stand in a doorway, lean forward for 30 seconds.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Arm Circles: Hold arms out to the sides, make small circles for 10-15 reps.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Lower Body:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Quad Stretch: Hold for 30 seconds, switch legs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Calf Stretch: Hold for 30 seconds, switch legs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Hamstring Stretch: Hold for 30 seconds.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Core and Hips:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Hip Circles: Move hips in a large circle for 10-15 reps.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Lunges: Walking or stationary lunges.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Piriformis Stretch: Hold for 30 seconds, switch legs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for flexibility: warm up before stretching, hold stretches for 30 seconds, breathe deeply, don’t bounce, and incorporate stretching 2-3 times a week.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User is interested in cardio exercises to complement kickboxing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended cardio exercises include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] High-Intensity Interval Training (HIIT):  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Burpees: 3 sets of 10-15 reps.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Jump Rope: 3-5 minutes of continuous jumping.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Tabata Workout: 20 seconds of effort, 10 seconds of rest for 8 rounds.
